stop.title: Stop everything in realm {{realm}}?
stop.body: Stops what is running in realm {{realm}} on {{computer}}: conversations mid-turn, background tasks and shell jobs the agents started. Messages already queued are not removed and may start afterwards. Loops are paused, not deleted. Other realms are untouched.
stop.estimate_one: About {{count}} thing looks to be running. That is an estimate; the real number is known only once it has run.
stop.estimate_other: About {{count}} things look to be running. That is an estimate; the real number is known only once it has run.
stop.headline: {{stopped}} stopped · {{already}} already done · {{failed}} may still be running
stop.reached: The agent reached everything it could see in this call. Work started after it may still be running.
stop.partial: This call did not reach everything. More may be left in this realm.
stop.capped: Pages stop at {{max}} in one sweep. Stop all again starts a fresh one.
stop.started_one: {{count}} thing started while this ran and was not stopped.
stop.started_other: {{count}} things started while this ran and were not stopped.
stop.unsure: The answer didn't arrive, so some of it may have been stopped and some may not. Nothing is resent by itself; stopping again is safe.
stop.refused: The agent refused to stop everything ({{code}}). Nothing was changed.
stop.refusedLater: The agent refused the latest request ({{code}}). What the earlier pages stopped stays stopped.
stop.refusedLaterNoCode: The agent refused the latest request. What the earlier pages stopped stays stopped.
stop.refusedNoCode: The agent refused to stop everything. Nothing was changed.
